quarterly_data.quarter: Siemens press release: Siemens and OMV deploy high-power charging for electric (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Siemens eMobility's SICHARGE FLEX high-power charging system (480 kW to 1.68 MW) went into operation at OMV's Kufstein, Austria station on September 29, 2026, which Siemens calls the world's first commercial deployment, with four car and two truck charge points of up to 400 kW each and four MCS truck charge points of 600 kW to 1,200 kW to follow; OMV, the pilot customer and first user, has ordered SICHARGE FLEX systems for additional locations in Austria, with delivery and commissioning in the coming months.
quarterly_data.figure: 480 kW to 1.68 MW system; six charge points
